channel.title: Events on Hsing-An Lee
channel.description: Hsing-An Lee is a recorder player and composer.

item.title: Musesound Recorder Quartet Concert, Taichung
item.content:encoded:
Musesound is heading to Taichung!

My chamber partners and I, Musesound Recorder Quartet, will be giving a concert in Taichung.
Since the other three members are all from Taichung, this is almost a hometown concert for them, which should feel quite relaxed.
As the only member from Taitung, what I am most looking forward to is probably the celebratory barbecue afterward.

Musesound has been one of the projects I have spent the most time on recently. Come listen if you are interested!

📅 Date: 2025-11-22
⏰ Performance time: 14:30
📍 Venue: Under the Big Tree Music Studio (4F, No. 290, Section 2, Nantun Road, Nantun District, Taichung)
🎫 Ticket link

item.title: Guanxi Love Song: Crossover Hakka Music Concert
item.description: Performing with Hsin-Chu Recorder Orchestra and Golden Melody Award-winning Hakka singer Zi-Xuan Huang, and providing arrangements for the ensemble.
item.content:encoded:
Performing with Golden Melody Award-winning singer Zi-Xuan Huang

On Nov. 8, I will perform with Hsin-Chu Recorder Orchestra and Golden Melody Award-winning Hakka singer Zi-Xuan Huang.
For this concert, I will not only perform as a recorder ensemble member, but also provide two arrangements for the program.

Admission is free. Come by if you are interested!

📅 Date: 2025-11-08
⏰ Performance time: 15:00
📍 Venue: 2F, Taihong Tea Culture Center (No. 73, Zhongshan Road, Guanxi Township, Hsinchu County)
🎫 Free admission

item.title: 2025 Vagabond Festival
item.description: Performing original and cover works in hip-hop, R&amp;B, Bossa Nova, and other fusion styles at Vagabond Festival.
item.content:encoded:
I am playing at a music festival!

I will be heading to Tainan with my band Long Time Don’t Jam for Vagabond Festival!
We will perform several original works in fusion styles around hip-hop, R&B, and Bossa Nova, along with a few covers and some fresh new material.

This will be my first time performing on a music festival stage, so I am a little nervous.
I have two performances that day (Oct. 18):

  • 16:00 Triggerman Beat Station
  • 21:10 Xiaoximen Stage

Come by if you are interested! Tickets are available here

📅 Date: 2025-10-18
⏰ Performance times: 16:00 / 21:10
📍 Venue: Grass field beside Anping Sunset Platform, Tainan
🎫 Ticket link
